protocol.model_identity_limit: Mutable alias; no verified fixed weights or training cutoff
protocol.comparison: Exact financial_facts block from the completed pilot versus the same base without it; no perspective cue, cognition answer block or purchase-frequency block.
protocol.month_selection: The four archived eight-period evaluation months, chosen for coverage across high inflation and later periods; none was used to tune Q1 wording. Previously inspected old simulations and full-sample associations exist. Not a pristine project-level blind holdout.
protocol.sampling: Within each archived SRS96 roster, proportionally sample48 by numeracy with largest-remainder rounding and fixed seed. No current Q8/Q9 or Q1 used to select; no missing-target replacement.
protocol.aggregation: Per month/repeat weighted median of fitted individual Q9 means for both model and observed same roster, then absolute error; equal average of8 month/repeat cells. Left-inverse empirical CDF throughout.
protocol.auxiliary_weights: Equal-person results reported separately. Primary evaluation weight=survey_weight / ((96/eligible_returners)*(selected_stratum_n/parent_stratum_n)); this is a sequential two-stage design weight, not proof of national representativeness.
protocol.macro_replication_screen: Primary center point contrast<0 and at least3 of4 monthly mean contrasts<=0; exploratory replication screen only.
protocol.overall_upgrade_rule: Macro screen alone is insufficient. Any worsening of personal density-mean MAE or cross-sectional W1 is explicitly a tradeoff; no overall upgrade. Report paired intervals and monthly results, never select another weight/prompt after inspecting results.
protocol.coverage_rule: Model valid and scorable fractions>=.99 in each arm; human missingness separate. All-arm/both-repeat common Q9 support, Q8 separate. Never resample to replace a missing or extreme current outcome.
protocol.intervals: 1000 paired person-cluster resamples retaining all available months/repeats for a person; exploratory.4 selected calendar months do not support a population claim over time. Monthly/repeat values always shown.
protocol.baseline_history: Same own valid prior bins and strict earlier histories, coefficient.5 fixed from existing baseline, not fitted to new months; scalar history anchor has no invented density.
protocol.q8: Separate secondary signed point response; abs<=100 sensitivity as in the existing evaluator; report exclusions.
protocol.financial_groups: worse Q1=1/2, same=3, better=4/5; other groups age/numeracy/income/region. Suppress group gaps unless both groups have>=3 common people in a cell; no subgroup claim from tiny samples.
protocol.truth_isolation: Only date/userid/financial_change/survey_date projected from hash-verified cache. Current Q8/Q9 are not loaded in preparation; only reference hash pinned. Actual current targets first read by the evaluation stage after frozen execution.
protocol.information_boundary: Current real Q1 and current demographics are explicitly retrospective A conditions; actual own prior Q8/Q9 and older summaries are supplied. Public E uses existing cutoffs. Not strict B, nationwide forecast, or free recursive belief simulation.
protocol.generations: Two repeats are API variability, not additional people. Engine seeds42/43 do not imply provider-enforced identical random seeds.
protocol.scorer: Same frozen approximate Q9 scorer for model and human raw bins; cannot claim exact official fitting.
limits: Returner-only conditional sample; four months are not enough to prove stability over all periods.
Q1 is subjective finances versus12 months earlier; current Q1 is not an identified exogenous income shock.
CE spending and Fed confidence remain synthetic proxies; NYT/gas snapshots do not gain strict historical-vintage certification from reuse.
Current target datasets have been explored in earlier aggregate research; only this preparation is target-isolated.

common_support.definition: All two arms and both repeats legal/scorable on the same truth; missing/invalid responses stay in assigned coverage.

facts_minus_baseline.scope: Respondent clusters retain all months/repeats; design weights remain fixed. Conditional on these four selected months; not a time-population interval.
facts_minus_baseline.interpretation: Macro screen only; any positive personal-MAE or W1 change is retained as a tradeoff and prevents an overall upgrade. No 0.2pp tolerance or causal claim.

kernel_migration.equivalence_check: 3,741 sealed holdout rows recomputed; zero per-field difference

scorer_provenance.approximation_notice: Research approximation of the Armantier et al. (2017) Appendix C generalized-beta fit, selected on a preregistered holdout; not the official FRBNY implementation. The same algorithm scores real and simulated questionnaires; differences from official headline values are reported separately.

individual_update_mae_identity: Against the same real prior, |(model-current - prior) - (real-current - prior)| equals |model-current - real-current|; one item of evidence.
scalar_baselines: Copy the same real previous belief; history-anchor=.5 previous+.5 mean of strictly earlier scored personal answers if >=2 histories, otherwise copy previous. Scalar baselines do not invent probability bins or individual uncertainty.
weighting: Model and matched human use the identical selected-person design_survey_weight within each month/repeat; eight cell metrics get equal weight. Equal-person sensitivity is auxiliary. Spearman is unweighted descriptive correlation.
limitations: Four old-framework evaluation months not used to tune Q1; not an overall project blind test.
Selected 48-person stratified returner samples, not national estimates.
Current Q1 is contemporaneous A conditional reconstruction, not causal Q1 effects or B real-time forecasts.
Intervals resample respondents conditional on four months; no inference to a time population or confirmed mechanism.
All worsening monthly or micro metrics are retained; previous pilot failure is not reversed by this macro screen.
